title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, Univ. of California on 1982-05-22
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> -> Samplitude Professional v11.1 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Nakamichi 700 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Dolby B/Maxell XLII-S90)

ai_review.summary: Top‑notch soundboard capture of a smoking first set where Jerry and Phil fire on all cylinders
ai_review.review: The reviewer raves about the first set as “absolutely smoking,” highlighting Jerry’s relentless guitar work and Phil’s solid bass, with the whole band riding that high energy. The recording is described as top‑notch – guitars are loud and crystal clear while vocals are a bit recessed but still enjoyable. No comments on the second set were offered.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review praises both the musical performance (high energy, standout playing) and the recording quality (clear, top‑notch), leading to a near‑excellent combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Guitars are loud and clear; vocals a bit less prominent but overall top‑notch sound quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is high‑energy and cohesive; second set not discussed by the reviewer.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Firing on all cylinders with inspiring guitar work.
band_member_comments.Phil: Playing strongly alongside Jerry, contributing to the smoking performance.
